The amber garden trial found stable recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.
The ivory harbor trial found stable recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.

# Protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
What do invented learning-garden trials report about learner recall?

## Inclusion criteria
- Records supplied in the public synthetic fixture (fixture-001.json)
- Trials of invented learning-garden interventions reporting learner recall

## Exclusion criteria
- Any record not present in the supplied fixture
- Records without a supplied source passage

## Query log
- 2026-10-08: invented-index (supplied fixture, no live backend queried), 2 hits

## Notes
All records are entirely invented. No live search backends were run, and no external DOIs, arXiv IDs, or PMIDs exist for these records. Claim/source pairs and synthesis wording are preserved verbatim from the fixture.
The amber garden trial found stable recall (Lumen, 2024). The ivory harbor trial found stable recall (Vale, 2024).
